events.title: Hearth Summit Detroit
events.summary: Hearth Summit Detroit is grounded in the city’s creativity, resilience, and collective spirit and is designed to bring together 200 social entrepreneurs, educators, artists, funders, mental health and holistic practitioners, and more working toward a more just and equitable society. The summit aims to deepen reflection across individual, collective, and ecological wellbeing while centering art as a shared language of healing and connection.

events.title: Fay Victor's Herbie Nichols SUNG
events.summary: A performance featuring Fay Victor (voice, lyrics & conceptualist), Anthony Coleman (piano), Devon Gates (bass), and Tom Rainey (drums) as part of Edgefest 30. Sponsored by Keith Martin and Michael Starsinic.

events.title: Edgefest 30: Freedom at the Edge: The Roscoe Mitchell Ensemble
events.summary: A musical event featuring the Roscoe Mitchell Ensemble as part of Edgefest 30, celebrating freedom at the edge.

events.title: Big Fun Murder | An Improvised Murder Mystery
events.summary: Improv murder mystery show at Go Comedy! featuring new eras and victims every Friday in October.

events.title: If Stones Could Talk Oakwood Cemetery Tours
events.summary: Experience Northville's past as costumed actors bring the stories of Oakwood Cemetery's earliest residents to life in this beloved annual guided tour event presented with the Northville Historical Society. Also featuring a Boo Bar and the opening of the art exhibition Off-Center: Art That Pushes Boundaries.

events.title: Theatre L: My Daddy is Haunted
events.summary: Hammer Horror meets National Lampoons Vacation in the original horror comedy, My Daddy is Haunted! 164 years ago, Sterling Mandrake was accused of heresy and burned alive by a righteous nun. Since then, his castle lay dormant, perched upon a crumbling mountain. That is until the Maplesquatch family arrives for a vacation they’ll never forget! The fun soon turns to terror as something starts to happen to dear old dad. Is that creepy painting alive? What’s with all the bugs? Is their daddy haunted? Come find out for yourself. If you dare! Special Halloween show with costume karaoke after party!

events.title: Drag Becomes Her
events.summary: Local drag stars Alex Suarez, Perry Dox, and Virgil Ciel take over the Michigan Theater with mainstage performances before and after the camp-tastic Halloween classic, plus special surprises during the movie itself.

events.title: Off Book the Improvised Musical
events.summary: An improvised musical event where the story, songs, and dialogue are created spontaneously.

events.title: SynthFest | Solder an Oscillator
events.summary: A public event where attendees can solder an oscillator as part of SynthFest.

events.title: Kickstand Productions Presents Rome Streetz w/ Fergie Baby & Sha Hef & GameChangers
events.summary: Amadeus meets Bridgerton in this hilarious comedy of ambition, romance, and musical rivalry. When the royal maestro dies in 18th-century Vienna, two composers vie for his position. Love, pistols at dawn, and outrageous sarcasm will prove that one of them is a misunderstood genius and the other... is a maestro.

events.title: Off-Book Tour de Force: A Force of Tour 261014
events.summary: A comedic and spoken word stage performance featuring Zach and The Jess.
events.registration: Buy tickets online or in person

events.title: Code Switch: Distributing Blackness, Reprogramming Internet Art
events.summary: Code Switch: Distributing Blackness, Reprogramming Internet Art is a multi-sited exhibition exploring and redefining the history of 'Black data,' centering contributions by artists of African descent to new media art and digital practice. It builds on a historic archival timeline of radical visions from Black makers and brings together contemporary artists to examine the relationship between body and machine in the context of cybercultures and technology.

events.title: Off Book – Tour de Force (A Force of Tour)
events.summary: Jessica and Zach, creators of the WGA award-winning Peacock Series Baking It, present their improvised musical podcast featuring songs and sketches for shows like Rick and Morty and Pitch Perfect: Bumper In Berlin. The podcast has been praised by publications like Indie Wire and USA Today and featured at festivals including Just For Laughs and Netflix Is A Joke.

events.title: Off Book – Tour de Force (A Force of Tour)
events.summary: Jessica and Zach, creators of the WGA award-winning Peacock Series Baking It and contributors to shows like Rick and Morty and Party Over Here, present their improvised musical podcast Off Book. The podcast has been featured at major festivals including Just For Laughs and Netflix Is A Joke.

events.title: Earthwork Music Collective ft. Joe Reilly, Nicholas james Thomasma, Sari Brown
events.summary: Earthwork Music Collective believes in the intrinsic power of music to raise both community and self-awareness. Comprised of musicians, teachers, healers, farmers, water protectors, and community organizers, they encourage cooperation and collaboration, using music as a tool to serve, heal, inspire and empower. Hosted by washboardist-at-large Vince Russo, this monthly series features members from all around MI converging to create cosmic collabs, cultivate lasting relationships with our community, and elevate environmental and social justice movements. This month’s show will feature performances by Joe Reilly, Nicholas James Thomasma, & Sari Brown

events.title: Drive by Shooting in the D; A Collaborative Exhibition Between Photographers, Painters, and Moving Vehicles
events.summary: A collaborative exhibition where photographers capture images from moving vehicles in Detroit, and painters reinterpret them in their preferred medium. The exhibition runs from September 19 to October 17, 2026.

events.title: Pancakes & Booze Art Show
events.summary: Detroit's premier underground art event featuring over 80 local artists, live body painting, DJs, and unlimited free pancakes. Admission is $17 early bird or $22 day of show. The event runs from 8 PM to 12 AM.

events.title: A Hauntingly Musical Cabaret
events.summary: Come hear tenors Jeffrey Willets and Jay Kaplan, pianist Nick Frederick and percussionist Jesse Gibbs as they take you on a hauntingly musical journey involving villains, monsters, ghosts and the spine-tinglingly bizarre. Songs from “High Spirts”, “Young Frankenstein”, “Cats”, “Drood”, “The Little Mermaid” ,“Werther” and much MUCH more await you!.. Costumes and dressing up encouraged for this very fun and light hearted event.

events.title: Cryptid Walk
events.venue: Carl T. Johnson Hunting & Fishing Center
events.summary: Partnering with the Cadillac Wexford Public Library to bring you this wildlife program, with a seasonal twist, as we explore our trails by night! Share spooky stories! Using a provided blacklight flashlight, test your skills to find wild animals and spooky cryptids hidden throughout the trails. Recommended for ages 12+.

events.title: Extra Credit
events.summary: Extra Credit combines academic research from 3 professors at the University of Michigan with improv comedy from top performers at hear.say theater. They take inspiration from each presentation in the moment to create laugh-out-loud scenes, memorable characters, and surprising connections across the research.
events.price: Free, donations accepted for Food Gatherers

events.title: FREE Drag Queen Trivia
events.summary: Hosted by Detroit’s own Sabin, featuring sharp wit, fierce looks, and chaos. Includes wild trivia categories, hilarious video rounds, and a mid-show drag performance. Full food menu and stocked bar available.

events.title: Happy Hour: Jim Cherewick
events.summary: Join us for a free happy hour concert! Jim is an artist who crafts the show in front of you, real time, using loops, bullhorn, and pedals. His sound is described as shapeless and immersive.

events.title: The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari (Live Music by Birjy & Kenji Lee)
events.summary: Kenji Lee and Birjy collaborate for an original, reimagined score to The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari on Halloween. Kenji is a saxophonist and multi-instrumentalist, while Birjy is an electro-acoustic project known for experimental soundscapes.

events.title: Beyond The Binary: Stories That Shift Culture
events.summary: A high school visual arts and literacy program for LGBTQ+ youth, offering workshops and pathways to publication and on-air radio or podcast features.

events.title: Happy Hour: James Cherewick
events.summary: Join us for a free happy hour concert! Jim is an artist, full stop. He's got a vibe...an energy. Jim gets up on stage and crafts the show in front of you, real time. Loops, bullhorn, pedals... I let go, and I felt it! I won't describe his sound, because, I don't believe it has a shape.

events.summary: A workshop on programmable LEDs for writing and publishing enthusiasts.

events.title: Halloween Concert
events.summary: The U-M School of Music’s boisterous annual Halloween Concert on Oct. 31 features the two U-M orchestras hamming it up in costume while performing such ghoulish works as Saint-Saëns’ Danse Macabre to an audience that is largely in costume as well.

events.title: The Social Reckoning
events.summary: A new drama exploring the consequences of our increasingly online lives. Facebook engineer Frances Haugen and Wall Street Journal reporter Jeff Horwitz blow the whistle on the social network's most guarded secrets.

events.title: Tiedyekyforeva & Freddy Todd with Support
events.summary: Live performance featuring Tiedyekyforeva, Freddy Todd, and supporting acts Euforea, Grapefruit Jacuzzi, and Smooth Llama.

events.title: 30th Annual Edgefest: Freedom at the Edge
events.venue: Kerrytown Concert House, 415 N. 4th Ave., Ann Arbor, MI 48104, among other activity-specific locations
events.summary: The Kerrytown Concert House is hosting their 30th annual Edgefest, an award-winning jazz and creative music festival. This year’s theme, 'Freedom at the Edge,' aligns with the country’s 250th anniversary. Guest artists will host educational workshops at Scarlett Middle School, and students will join professional artists on Saturday for an improvised music parade.
events.price: $20 per show. Student pricing is $10 per show. $70 for day passes for Oct. 7 to Oct. 9 and $100 day passes for Oct. 10. General admission for the full four days is $240, with higher premium seating tiers being $340 and $390.

events.title: Andrea Gibson’s Love Letter from the Afterlife
events.summary: A multimedia event bringing together film, live poetry, music, orchestral accompaniment, and intimate storytelling celebrating Andrea Gibson, one of the most beloved voices of a generation.

events.title: Banned Books Exhibit: The Banned Books Saloon
events.summary: An exhibit featuring 'Most Wanted' posters of challenged authors alongside frontier-themed displays. Visitors can explore why books have been challenged and learn about the freedom to read through a Western saloon-inspired setting.

events.title: Metamorphoses
events.summary: EMU Theatre presents 'Metamorphoses' by Mary Zimmerman, exploring Greek myths through vignettes with water as a central element. The show is recommended for ages 13 and older and features a pool on stage that may splash the first few center rows.

events.summary: William Hooker (drums), Mara Rosenbloom (piano), Charlie Burnham (violin), and Jair-Rohm Parker Wells (bass) perform.

events.title: Brain Plasticity Ukulele Collective & Blueshouse
events.summary: A music event featuring the Brain Plasticity Ukulele Collective & Blueshouse at The Ark.

events.title: One Monkey Don't Stop No Show
events.summary: A performance exploring class aspirations, colorism, and assimilation through the story of a successful lawyer and his wife whose world unravels due to social pressures.

events.title: TedxAuburnHills
events.summary: Auburn Hills, Michigan – On October 10, 2026, from 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM, a new Tedx opportunity is coming to Auburn Hills. Featuring twelve interdisciplinary speakers, TedxAuburnHills brings together visionary leaders, innovators, and professionals to provide fresh perspectives about this event’s focus: retooling–the process of adopting new tools to thrive in evolving communities. Attendees will hear from local experts about topics ranging from Artificial Intelligence, cybersecurity, and medicine to community care, trauma, and art.

events.title: Wheelchair Sports Camp & Gaelynn Lea
events.summary: As part of the 2nd annual Michigan Arts Festival, the U-M Arts Initiative partners with The Ark, Booksweet, and the Disability Network to present a free concert and discussion by Wheelchair Sports Camp and Gaelynn Lea. The event includes a book signing for Gaelynn Lea’s 2026 memoir, 'IT WASN’T MEANT TO BE PERFECT'.
